trap-nonspeakable.notes: Separate (non-trap) findings, all recomputed at 30 dps. (A) CONVENTION C, AND LOAD-BEARING. The block sets z = 1/(sqrt q + 1/sqrt q), which AGENTS.md names verbatim as an excised convention-C spelling; at the proton pin q_0 = 1.1099785827513808 it equals 0.4993203342, against canonical convention D z = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.6126880371. The eigenphase alpha = (z-1)h/2 therefore moves from -0.05233612 to -0.04048578 (h = 0.2090602988) and the cos factor from 0.9986307778 to 0.9991805629 — a shift of 550.5 ppm. The block's headline is "matching CODATA to 305 ppm at the cos-resummation level", so the convention swap moves the prediction by 1.8x the agreement it claims: this is NOT a cosmetic z-substitution, and per the AGENTS.md convention-D ruling the result must be re-derived, not re-spelled. (B) The Hoefsmit algebra CHECKS OUT: d_1 + d_2 = (q^3 - q^{-1})/(q^2+1) = q - q^{-1} = h and d_1 d_2 - b c = -1, so Cayley-Hamilton gives M^2 = hM + I exactly as claimed; the .ts note's b^2 = (h^2+3)/(h^2+4) is also identical to d_1 d_2 + 1 = (q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1)^2. (C) Same conditional-banner defect as prop:hecke-1d-irrep-closed-form-character: the banner claims conditionality on conj:borromean-quark while uses[] lists only prop:hecke-1d-irrep-closed-form-character. (D) The .ts authorNotes claim the decomposition is "verified bit-exact at 50 dps" via computations/probe_q_beta_three_irrep_closed_form.py and computations/probe_q_beta_1d_irrep_universal.py; NEITHER FILE EXISTS in the tree, and both links use the ../../computations/ prefix, which from mass-theory resolves to content/computations (also nonexistent).
